Meanwhile an army of Orcs led by Azog the Defiler is marching on Erebor, fueled by the rise of the dark lord Sauron. Dwarves, elves and men must unite, and the hope for Middle-Earth falls into Bilbo's hands.

tmdb:/3/movie/122?append_to_response=vid.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
tmdb:/3/movie/122?append_to_response=vid.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
tmdb:/3/movie/122?append_to_response=vid.overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​

tmdb:/3/movie/1233413?append_to_response.title: Sinners

tmdb:/3/movie/12444?append_to_response=v.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
tmdb:/3/movie/12444?append_to_response=v.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1

tmdb:/3/movie/12445?append_to_response=v.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
tmdb:/3/movie/12445?append_to_response=v.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

tmdb:/3/movie/12477?append_to_response=v.title: Grave of the Fireflies

tmdb:/3/movie/1265609?append_to_response.title: War Machine
tmdb:/3/movie/1265609?append_to_response.overview: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

tmdb:/3/movie/1272837?append_to_response.overview: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

tmdb:/3/movie/1273221?append_to_response.title: Scary Movie
tmdb:/3/movie/1273221?append_to_response.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

tmdb:/3/movie/1275779?append_to_response.title: Disclosure Day
tmdb:/3/movie/1275779?append_to_response.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

tmdb:/3/movie/127585?append_to_response=.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
tmdb:/3/movie/127585?append_to_response=.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

tmdb:/3/movie/128?append_to_response=vid.title: Princess Mononoke
tmdb:/3/movie/128?append_to_response=vid.overview: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

tmdb:/3/movie/1290821?append_to_response.title: Shelter
tmdb:/3/movie/1290821?append_to_response.overview: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.

tmdb:/3/movie/1297842?append_to_response.title: GOAT
tmdb:/3/movie/1297842?append_to_response.overview: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

tmdb:/3/movie/129?append_to_response=vid.title: Spirited Away
tmdb:/3/movie/129?append_to_response=vid.overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

tmdb:/3/movie/12?append_to_response=vide.title: Finding Nemo
tmdb:/3/movie/12?append_to_response=vide.overview: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring Nemo home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.

tmdb:/3/movie/1302904?append_to_response.title: Practical Magic 2
tmdb:/3/movie/1302904?append_to_response.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

tmdb:/3/movie/1304313?append_to_response.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
tmdb:/3/movie/1304313?append_to_response.overview: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

tmdb:/3/movie/1306368?append_to_response.title: The Rip
tmdb:/3/movie/1306368?append_to_response.overview: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

tmdb:/3/movie/1311031?append_to_response.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

tmdb:/3/movie/1314481?append_to_response.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2

tmdb:/3/movie/131631?append_to_response=.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
tmdb:/3/movie/131631?append_to_response=.overview: After surviving the Quarter Quell, Katniss finds herself in the hidden stronghold of District 13, where the rebellion against the Capitol is gaining momentum. Struggling with the weight of becoming the symbol of resistance, she must navigate fragile alliances while trying to protect those she loves. As propaganda battles rage and Panem moves closer to full-scale war, Katniss is forced to confront the true cost of revolution.

tmdb:/3/movie/1318447?append_to_response.title: Apex
tmdb:/3/movie/1318447?append_to_response.overview: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.

tmdb:/3/movie/1325734?append_to_response.title: The Drama
tmdb:/3/movie/1325734?append_to_response.overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

tmdb:/3/movie/1327819?append_to_response.title: Hoppers
tmdb:/3/movie/1327819?append_to_response.overview: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

tmdb:/3/movie/1339713?append_to_response.title: Obsession
tmdb:/3/movie/1339713?append_to_response.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

tmdb:/3/movie/135397?append_to_response=.title: Jurassic World
tmdb:/3/movie/135397?append_to_response=.overview: Twenty-two years after the events of Jurassic Park, Isla Nublar now features a fully functioning dinosaur theme park, Jurassic World, as originally envisioned by John Hammond.

tmdb:/3/movie/1368337?append_to_response.title: The Odyssey
tmdb:/3/movie/1368337?append_to_response.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

tmdb:/3/movie/137113?append_to_response=.title: Edge of Tomorrow
tmdb:/3/movie/137113?append_to_response=.overview: Major Bill Cage is an officer who has never seen a day of combat when he is unceremoniously demoted and dropped into combat. Cage is killed within minutes, managing to take an alpha alien down with him. He awakens back at the beginning of the same day and is forced to fight and die again... and again - as physical contact with the alien has thrown him into a time loop.

tmdb:/3/movie/1375441?append_to_response.title: Primetime
tmdb:/3/movie/1375441?append_to_response.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, turning an undercover investigation into one of the most controversial cultural phenomena of the decade.

tmdb:/3/movie/1375646?append_to_response.title: Colony
tmdb:/3/movie/1375646?append_to_response.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

tmdb:/3/movie/1377237?append_to_response.title: Runner
tmdb:/3/movie/1377237?append_to_response.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

tmdb:/3/movie/1384216?append_to_response.title: The Dog Stars
tmdb:/3/movie/1384216?append_to_response.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

tmdb:/3/movie/138843?append_to_response=.title: The Conjuring
tmdb:/3/movie/138843?append_to_response=.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.

tmdb:/3/movie/1398?append_to_response=vi.title: Stalker
tmdb:/3/movie/1398?append_to_response=vi.overview: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A stalker guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.

tmdb:/3/movie/13?append_to_response=vide.title: Forrest Gump
tmdb:/3/movie/13?append_to_response=vide.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.

tmdb:/3/movie/140607?append_to_response=.title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
tmdb:/3/movie/140607?append_to_response=.overview: Thirty years after defeating the Galactic Empire, Han Solo and his allies face a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren and his army of Stormtroopers.

tmdb:/3/movie/14069?append_to_response=v.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
tmdb:/3/movie/14069?append_to_response=v.overview: When 17-year-old Makoto Konno gains the ability to 'leap' backwards through time, she immediately sets about improving her grades and preventing personal mishaps. However, she soon realises that changing the past isn't as simple as it seems, and eventually, will have to rely on her new powers to shape the future of herself and her friends.

tmdb:/3/movie/14160?append_to_response=v.title: Up
tmdb:/3/movie/14160?append_to_response=v.overview: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.

tmdb:/3/movie/1422011?append_to_response.title: It Ends
tmdb:/3/movie/1422011?append_to_response.overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

tmdb:/3/movie/1422?append_to_response=vi.title: The Departed
tmdb:/3/movie/1422?append_to_response=vi.overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.

tmdb:/3/movie/1423191?append_to_response.title: Resident Evil
tmdb:/3/movie/1423191?append_to_response.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

tmdb:/3/movie/1437396?append_to_response.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
tmdb:/3/movie/1437396?append_to_response.original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
tmdb:/3/movie/1437396?append_to_response.overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

tmdb:/3/movie/1439930?append_to_response.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
tmdb:/3/movie/1439930?append_to_response.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

tmdb:/3/movie/144?append_to_response=vid.title: Wings of Desire
tmdb:/3/movie/144?append_to_response=vid.overview: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.

tmdb:/3/movie/1465063?append_to_response.title: Forgotten Island
tmdb:/3/movie/1465063?append_to_response.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

tmdb:/3/movie/14836?append_to_response=v.title: Coraline
tmdb:/3/movie/14836?append_to_response=v.overview: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.

cast.name: Ian McShane
cast.character: Mr. Sergei Alexander Bobinsky / Other Bobinsky (voice)

tmdb:/3/movie/149871?append_to_response=.title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
tmdb:/3/movie/149871?append_to_response=.overview: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady. The mysterious young princess enthrals all who encounter her. But, ultimately, she must confront her fate.

tmdb:/3/movie/150540?append_to_response=.title: Inside Out
tmdb:/3/movie/150540?append_to_response=.overview: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

tmdb:/3/movie/152601?append_to_response=.title: Her
tmdb:/3/movie/152601?append_to_response=.overview: In the not so distant future, Theodore, a lonely writer, purchases a newly developed operating system designed to meet the user's every need. To Theodore's surprise, a romantic relationship develops between him and his operating system. This unconventional love story blends science fiction and romance in a sweet tale that explores the nature of love and the ways that technology isolates and connects us all.

tmdb:/3/movie/155?append_to_response=vid.title: The Dark Knight
tmdb:/3/movie/155?append_to_response=vid.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

tmdb:/3/movie/156022?append_to_response=.title: The Equalizer
tmdb:/3/movie/156022?append_to_response=.overview: McCall believes he has put his mysterious past behind him and dedicated himself to beginning a new, quiet life. But when he meets Teri, a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters, he can’t stand idly by – he has to help her. Armed with hidden skills that allow him to serve vengeance against anyone who would brutalize the helpless, McCall comes out of his self-imposed retirement and finds his desire for justice reawakened. If someone has a problem, if the odds are stacked against them, if they have nowhere else to turn, McCall will help. He is The Equalizer.

tmdb:/3/movie/157336?append_to_response=.title: Interstellar
tmdb:/3/movie/157336?append_to_response=.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

tmdb:/3/movie/1621552?append_to_response.title: Facing El Chapo
tmdb:/3/movie/1621552?append_to_response.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

tmdb:/3/movie/1628?append_to_response=vi.title: Jules and Jim
tmdb:/3/movie/1628?append_to_response=vi.overview: In the carefree days before World War I, introverted Austrian author Jules strikes up a friendship with the exuberant Frenchman Jim and both men fall for the impulsive and beautiful Catherine.

tmdb:/3/movie/1630423?append_to_response.title: My Dearest Assassin
tmdb:/3/movie/1630423?append_to_response.original_title: เลือดรักนักฆ่า
tmdb:/3/movie/1630423?append_to_response.overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

tmdb:/3/movie/1678?append_to_response=vi.title: Godzilla
tmdb:/3/movie/1678?append_to_response=vi.overview: Japan is thrown into a panic after several ships are sunk near Odo Island. An expedition to the island led by Dr. Kyohei Yamane soon discover something far more devastating than imagined in the form of a 50 meter tall monster whom the natives call Gojira. Now the monster begins a rampage that threatens to destroy not only Japan, but the rest of the world as well.

tmdb:/3/movie/16869?append_to_response=v.title: Inglourious Basterds
tmdb:/3/movie/16869?append_to_response=v.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.

tmdb:/3/movie/1726?append_to_response=vi.title: Iron Man
tmdb:/3/movie/1726?append_to_response=vi.overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

tmdb:/3/movie/1771?append_to_response=vi.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
tmdb:/3/movie/1771?append_to_response=vi.overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

tmdb:/3/movie/177572?append_to_response=.title: Big Hero 6
tmdb:/3/movie/177572?append_to_response=.overview: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

tmdb:/3/movie/181808?append_to_response=.title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
tmdb:/3/movie/181808?append_to_response=.overview: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

tmdb:/3/movie/18491?append_to_response=v.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
tmdb:/3/movie/18491?append_to_response=v.original_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン劇場版 Air／まごころを、君に
tmdb:/3/movie/18491?append_to_response=v.overview: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project. Shinji is pushed to the limits of his sanity as he is forced to decide the fate of humanity.

tmdb:/3/movie/185?append_to_response=vid.title: A Clockwork Orange
tmdb:/3/movie/185?append_to_response=vid.overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?

tmdb:/3/movie/18785?append_to_response=v.title: The Hangover
tmdb:/3/movie/18785?append_to_response=v.overview: When three friends finally come to after a raucous night of bachelor-party revelry, they find a baby in the closet and a tiger in the bathroom. But they can't seem to locate their best friend, Doug – who's supposed to be tying the knot. Launching a frantic search for Doug, the trio perseveres through a nasty hangover to try to make it to the church on time.

tmdb:/3/movie/1891?append_to_response=vi.title: The Empire Strikes Back
tmdb:/3/movie/1891?append_to_response=vi.overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

tmdb:/3/movie/1892?append_to_response=vi.title: Return of the Jedi
tmdb:/3/movie/1892?append_to_response=vi.overview: Luke Skywalker leads a mission to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt, the Emperor prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful Death Star, and the Rebel fleet mounts a massive attack on the space station. Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader in a final climactic duel before the evil Emperor.

tmdb:/3/movie/1893?append_to_response=vi.title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
tmdb:/3/movie/1893?append_to_response=vi.original_title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
tmdb:/3/movie/1893?append_to_response=vi.overview: Anakin Skywalker, a young slave strong with the Force, is discovered on Tatooine. Meanwhile, the evil Sith have returned, enacting their plot for revenge against the Jedi.

tmdb:/3/movie/18?append_to_response=vide.title: The Fifth Element
tmdb:/3/movie/18?append_to_response=vide.overview: In 2257, a taxi driver is unintentionally given the task of saving a young girl who is part of the key that will ensure the survival of humanity.

tmdb:/3/movie/1923?append_to_response=vi.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
tmdb:/3/movie/1923?append_to_response=vi.original_title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
tmdb:/3/movie/1923?append_to_response=vi.overview: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl.
